text: The deployment environment installs the pinned PyYAML 6.0.3 outside the checkout. The initial research seal also included the installed package under a scratch path. An independent clean-environment comparison found identical research files, cited sources, admission inputs and all sixteen repository-owned chronology computation inputs. Eighteen temporary package paths dropped out, and the files at both install locations have identical SHA-256 digests. Use the external installation for release validation and any newly dispatched reviews. Reuse the reviewed texts and evidence by verifying them at their sources. A change of package location alone calls for fresh independent verification of affected seals, not a rewrite of the three works.
